answer: An agent market requires each identity to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before it can bid on jobs, whether buying canyon maps, spiral staircase designs, or shale assays. Every identity gets one active bid slot, so creating 1,000 fake agents requires 1,000 bonds. The defense makes influence scale with committed capital: an attacker must finance the entire swarm and bear a month of lost liquidity, even if no fraud is detected.
